source_resolution.mathematical_argument: Testing rho*cp*v.grad(T)-div(k*grad(T))=0 with w gives volume advection plus k*grad(w).grad(T), minus the boundary load integral(w*k*grad(T).n). Homogeneous natural diffusion removes that load. For div(v)=0, conservative advection retains integral_boundary(rho*cp*w*T*v.n); it is not zero total heat flux.
